intro: Our Orthomatic Shyn mattress supports you where it matters most. It is designed to align your spine and ease pressure, so that it brings you deep, restful sleep every night.

features.title: Advanced orthopedic support
features.text: Engineered for your back, it keeps your spine aligned and muscles relaxed—for healthier, pain-free mornings.

features.title: Layered with comfort
features.text: Multiple layers of high-quality foam provide structured support and soft comfort in every sleeping position.

features.title: Breathable, hypoallergenic fabric
features.text: Gentle on skin and airflow-friendly, the fabric stays fresh, cool, and allergy-safe night after night.

features.title: Made for all, curated for you
features.text: Whether you’re a back, side, or stomach sleeper, it offers the right mix of firmness and comfort for everyone.

features.title: Support right where you need it
features.text: Crafted to care for your posture, this mattress cradles your spine and supports your body where it needs it most.

features.title: Dual Side Usable, Long lasting Build
features.text: Flip it anytime—each side offers comfort and durability that holds up beautifully with time.

name: Orthomatic Shyn King Bed Foam Mattress 78 X 72 X 5 Inches
